description: Frontend foundation: DTO types, room service methods, resilient WebSocket client (subprotocol auth, full-jitter backoff, give-up -> LOST with manual reconnect, online/visibility triggers, heartbeat watchdog, close-code handling), connection store statuses, auction store changes (snapshot-derived activity feed, sequence dedupe, host presence), ConnectionStatus indicator with the four states, and node protocol tests. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (types mirror their payloads). See plan.md decisions 6, 10-12 and items 7-8. Read frontend/AGENTS.md and the relevant node_modules/next/dist/docs guide before touching Next code.
steps: frontend/src/types/backend.ts: add RoomSummaryDTO, RoomDetailsDTO, ActivityDTO, TeamPresenceDTO, OngoingStatus union; extend RoomStateDTO with activity, recentBids, lastActivityAt, ongoingStatus, resumePath, teamPresence?; extend PRESENCE_UPDATED payload with optional teamPresence; keep parseServerEvent tolerant (frontend must not import backend files).
frontend/src/services/room.service.ts: add myRooms() (GET /me/rooms), summary(code) (GET /rooms/:code/summary), rejoin(code) (POST /rooms/:code/rejoin, no body fields) using validRoomCode.

frontend/src/services/websocket.service.ts: open the socket with `new WebSocket(baseUrl, ['auction.v1','bearer.'+token])` (no token in the URL); backoff `random(0,min(30000,1000*2^attempt))` with 500 ms floor; after 8 failed attempts set status LOST and stop; public reconnect() resets attempts and retries; listen to window online/pageshow/visibilitychange(visible) to attempt immediately when not SYNCED (remove listeners in disconnect()); app-level PING every 20 s while SYNCED and force-close/reconnect if no frame in 55 s; onclose code 4001 -> try fresh token, if none set AUTH_EXPIRED and do not retry; code 4003 -> LOST without auto retry; keep rejecting pending commands with CONNECTION_LOST and never marking an unconfirmed command as success; keep manager-mode connection paths working.
frontend/src/stores/connection.store.ts: extend ConnectionStateStatus with LOST and AUTH_EXPIRED; add attempt, lostSince, reconnectedAt (set when SYNCED is reached after RECONNECTING/LOST).

frontend/src/stores/auction.store.ts: set activityFeed and recentBids from snapshot.activity/recentBids on every ROOM_STATE (drop incremental duplicate-prone feed ids), drop non-ROOM_STATE events with sequence>0 and <= snapshot sequence except PRESENCE_UPDATED, apply PRESENCE_UPDATED teamPresence, add reconnect() action delegating to webSocketService.reconnect(), keep retention announcement dedupe untouched.

frontend/src/components/auction/ConnectionStatus.tsx: render CONNECTED, RECONNECTING, CONNECTION LOST, RECONNECTED (4 s after recovery) pills with role=status aria-live=polite; show 'Connection lost. Trying to reconnect to your auction...' only after 3 s not synced; show 'You're back! Reconnected to your team.' after recovery; 'Reconnect to Auction' button (calls store reconnect) on LOST and a 'Sign in again' link plus the expiry message on AUTH_EXPIRED; no modal. Keep props (status, latencyMs) so AuctionHeader, lobby and retention page compile.

Update frontend/tests/websocket-protocol.mjs WebSocket stub for the protocols argument; create frontend/tests/reconnect-protocol.mjs covering every case in plan.md item 8 (stub Math.random, fake timers, stub WebSocket, mocked auth service as in websocket-protocol.mjs; test auction.store sequence rules by bundling it the same way).
acceptance_criteria: The socket is opened with subprotocols and the URL has no token query
Backoff delays stay within the jittered bounds; 8 failures end in LOST; reconnect() and the online event reopen the socket
Silent connection triggers a forced reconnect after 55 s; 4001 gives AUTH_EXPIRED without retry

Unconfirmed commands are rejected on disconnect and never applied; stale or equal-sequence events are ignored; PRESENCE_UPDATED still applies; activity feed has no duplicates after repeated ROOM_STATE
npm run typecheck and next build succeed; websocket-protocol.mjs and reconnect-protocol.mjs pass
verification: cd frontend; node tests/websocket-protocol.mjs; node tests/reconnect-protocol.mjs
findings:
Ran (cd frontend): npm run typecheck PASS; npx next build PASS; node tests/websocket-protocol.mjs PASS (stub now asserts subprotocols ['auction.v1','bearer.test-token'] and no token in URL); node tests/reconnect-protocol.mjs PASS (new: subprotocol auth, backoff bounds, give-up to LOST after 8 attempts + reconnect(), online/visibilitychange, PING 20 s + 55 s watchdog, 4001 -> retry with fresh token / AUTH_EXPIRED without session, 4003 -> LOST no auto retry, pending commands rejected CONNECTION_LOST, store sequence rules, PRESENCE_UPDATED at equal sequence, feed replaced by snapshot). Regression: auction-redesign-ui PASS (assertion changed from 'LIVE SYNC' to getByText('CONNECTED',{exact:true})), skip-vote-ui PASS, recall-ui PASS. retention-ui.mjs FAILS with a TimeoutError on button 'Retain Kylian Mbappe Full' both with and without my changes (pre-existing baseline). UTF-8 scan clean.
For FEAT-004: types in src/types/backend.ts: OngoingStatus, RoomSummaryDTO, RoomDetailsDTO, ActivityDTO, RecentBidDTO, TeamPresenceDTO; RoomStateDTO has optional activity, recentBids, lastActivityAt, ongoingStatus, resumePath, teamPresence (host only); PRESENCE_UPDATED payload has optional teamPresence. roomService.myRooms()/summary(code)/rejoin(code). Connection store: statuses add LOST and AUTH_EXPIRED; fields attempt, lostSince, reconnectedAt. auction.store: reconnect() action; snapshot.teamPresence is updated by PRESENCE_UPDATED (host panel can read useAuctionStore(s=>s.snapshot?.teamPresence)); activityFeed/recentBids replaced from snapshot (ActivityEntry kind adds RECALLED; RETENTION detail mapped to 'skipped retention'/'retained N player(s)'); the incremental feed entries still exist only as a fallback until the next ROOM_STATE. ConnectionStatus labels: CONNECTING, CONNECTED, RECONNECTING, CONNECTION LOST, RECONNECTED (4 s), DISCONNECTED (idle); wrapper has data-testid=connection-status, role=status, aria-live=polite; 'Reconnect to Auction' button on LOST/AUTH_EXPIRED; sign-in link /auth/signin; 'Connection lost...' message appears after 3 s. Auction page still shows its own connection text for CONNECTING/RECONNECTING/DISCONNECTED (src/app/auction/[roomCode]/page.tsx line ~171-182) and does not handle LOST/AUTH_EXPIRED there; FEAT-004 should add that. webSocketService exports MAX_ATTEMPTS (8) and backoffDelay. Deviation: the 'UNAUTHENTICATED' ERROR no longer calls disconnect() (the 4001 close handler now decides retry vs AUTH_EXPIRED).
